blocks.text: You can resolve, snooze, unsnooze, or reset the issues as required.

AI Security generates issues for any policy violations or misconfigurations that are detected in your cloud resources. You might want to manually resolve issues that are not critical or do not pose any issues.

blocks.item: To resolve an issue, you must be assigned either an administrator role or a custom role with the Resolve Issues permission. If you have the Resolve Issues permission, you are automatically assigned permissions to reset manually resolved issues.

When you manually resolve an issue, the issue is resolved only in the AI Security Admin Portal and the policy violation persists in the cloud service provider (CSP). The issue remains in the resolved state until you reset it.

blocks.text: To resolve a single issue or multiple issues:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Issues > Issues.
Select the All Issues tab, and resolve the issue on the Issues page or an individual issue's details page:
Issues Page
Locate the required issue, click the Actions () icon, then select Resolve.
See image.
To resolve multiple issues, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Resolve.
See image.
In the Resolve Issue window, enter the reason for resolving the issue.
Click Resolve.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the issues are successfully resolved.

blocks.text: When you do not want to take any action for an issue at the moment, or you do not want to be notified for an issue, you can manually snooze the issue and specify the duration. When you snooze an issue, the issue notifications are paused and not shared with the recipients or third-party integrations within the specified snooze period.

blocks.item: To snooze an issue, you must be assigned either an administrator role or a custom role with the Snooze Issues permission. If you have the Snooze Issues permission, you are automatically assigned permissions to reset snoozed issues.
A snoozed issue remains snoozed for the specified duration if the issue is resolved in the CSP or if the resource or policy is deleted.

blocks.text: To snooze a single issue or multiple issues:

blocks.item: Go to AI Infrastructure > Issues > Issues View.
Snooze the issue on the Issues View page:
Issues Page
Locate the required issue, click the Actions () icon, then select Snooze.
See image.
To snooze multiple issues, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Snooze.
See image.
In the Snooze Issue window:
Reason for Snooze: Enter the reason for snoozing the issue.
Snooze End Date: Select the duration until when you want to snooze the issue.
By default, the issue is snoozed for 1 day.
Click Snooze.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the issues are snoozed.

blocks.text: If you've accidentally snoozed an issue, or you want to start receiving notifications for a snoozed issue, you can unsnooze it. When you unsnooze an issue, the status of the issue is updated based on the latest policy findings.
To unsnooze a single issue or multiple issues:

blocks.item: Go to AI Infrastructure > Issues > Issues View.
Select the All Issues tab, and unsnooze the issue on the Issues page:
Issues View Page
Locate the required snoozed issue, click the Actions () icon, then select Unsnooze.
See image.
To unsnooze multiple snoozed issues, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Unsnooze.
See image.
In the Unsnooze Issue window, click Unsnooze.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the issues are unsnoozed.

blocks.text: If you've accidentally resolved an issue, you can reset the issue. When you reset an issue, the status of the issue is updated based on the latest policy findings.
To reset a single issue or multiple issues:

blocks.item: Go to AI Infrastructure > Issues > Issues View.
Select the All Issues tab, and reset the issue on the Issues page or an individual issue's page:
Issues Page
Locate the required resolved issue, click the Actions () icon, then select Reset.
See image.
To reset multiple resolved issues, select the corresponding checkboxes. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Reset.
See image.
In the Reset Issue window, click Reset.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the issues are reset based on the latest policy findings.

blocks.text: Click the Issue ID of the snoozed issue to view that individual issue's page. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Unsnooze.
Click the Issue ID to view that individual issue's page. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Snooze.
